text:
- [LGRA.13.5] Series declaration: every observation line names a
  satisfiable (aggregation, time-model) pair per
  [LSER.13.3], [LSER.15.2] and [LSER.17];
  durations and sample counts are positive, and one that is not is
  `DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_NONPOSITIVE_WINDOW`; the `by:` block
  kwarg names a slot of the bound schema or the literal `none`,
  and is required wherever the schema declares no identity to
  follow ([LSER.7.6.1]);
  duplicate `(label, aggregation)` pairs are rejected per
  [LSER.6.8.6]
